_readThisFirst.untrackedSource: Large parts of lib/ were never tracked in git. `git clean` would delete working runtime code. Never run it.

W-A1.rootCause: 23 lib modules destructured DatabaseSync from better-sqlite3, which exports only SqliteError. DatabaseSync is the node:sqlite builtin. Every one threw on `new DatabaseSync()`.
W-A1.changed: All 23 switched to require('node:sqlite'). Classified first: none use pragma/function/backup/loadExtension, so all take the identical fix. lib/kanban/db-schema.js uses the genuine better-sqlite3 constructor API and was deliberately NOT changed.
